original.heading: A destination for another day
paragraphs: The page you followed has not been built yet. We are recreating the institute’s website one page at a time.
Your destination is saved in the address as the from parameter. Nothing is missing from your browser; this part of the site is in the build queue.

pirate.heading: Beyond the edge o’ the map
paragraphs: This stretch o’ The Isle is still uncharted. Our crew be rebuilding the institute one page at a time, with knowledge as the treasure. Mostly.
Yer destination be tucked into the address after from. The map is fine; the shipbuilders simply haven’t reached this shore yet.
